timeline.title: The Veiling of the Mystical World
timeline.summary: Mystical species withdraw from the mainland and establish protected districts where their cultures and magic can endure unseen.

events.title: The Great Passage
events.description: The first families cross into the concealed territories under the protection of ancient ward-makers.

events.title: The District Accord
events.description: Leaders define the districts, their responsibilities, and the laws that preserve secrecy from magicless humanity.

timeline.title: The Mystical Legends Assemble
timeline.summary: Avery, Teddric, and River are drawn together as unusual magical disturbances begin spreading between the districts.

events.title: A Light Awakens
events.description: Avery Obtainia's connection to the mage goddess Lynnhera begins to surface through unstable bursts of light and gravity magic.

events.title: An Unlikely Team
events.description: Teddric's runecrafted technology and River's water magic help Avery contain a disturbance before it reaches the public.

events.title: Kaden's Directive
events.description: Kaden Icelander begins investigating the same incidents through Icelander Tech and takes command of the emerging response.

timeline.title: Pyrus Bourn Makes His Move
timeline.summary: The ruler of the Volcanic Lair accelerates his search for the Orb of Destruction, forcing the young heroes into open conflict.

events.title: The Fire Increaser Raid
events.description: Pyrus's forces seize rare catalysts while Tom, Tony, and Ellie carry out competing interpretations of his orders.

events.title: The Orb's Echo
events.description: Avery senses the lost Orb of Destruction through the catalyst fused to Lynnhera, revealing that the relic is closer than anyone believed.

events.title: Stand at the Glass Bridge
events.description: The Mystical Legends prevent a district-wide disaster, but Pyrus escapes with knowledge that changes the balance of power.

timeline.title: Shadows Beyond the Veil
timeline.summary: Lordius Doomolo watches the districts from the dark, preparing a campaign that could expose the mystical world forever.

events.title: The Shadow Manifesto
events.description: Evidence emerges of a plan to end the age of hiding and place mystical beings above humanity.
